title.zh: 应用材料斥资50亿美元建设芯片研发中心，目标将AI芯片开发周期缩短一半
title.en: 应用材料斥资50亿美元建设芯片研发中心，目标将AI芯片开发周期缩短一半

current_state.zh: Applied Materials unveiled its $5 billion EPIC semiconductor R&D center in Sunnyvale, California, with Intel, TSMC, Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung stationing research teams on site, aiming to cut next-generation AI chip development cycles from 10-12 years to as fast as 6 years.
current_state.en: Applied Materials unveiled its $5 billion EPIC semiconductor R&D center in Sunnyvale, California, with Intel, TSMC, Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung stationing research teams on site, aiming to cut next-generation AI chip development cycles from 10-12 years to as fast as 6 years.
